title: HoroClaimEmission
description: Common Claim Emission Schema for all L3/L4 Interpretation Nodes in Horo Architecture v3.0. Every node MUST emit results in this format — no exceptions.

node_id.description: Unique identifier of the emitting node (e.g. '@Horo_BaZi_Node')

tradition_domain.description: The metaphysics tradition domain this node belongs to

session_id.description: Execution session identifier — links this emission to a specific inference run

emitted_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of claim emission

input_state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the L2 State Matrix received by this node — enables Derivation DAG linking

claims.description: Array of atomic interpretive claims. Each claim is independently verifiable.

AtomicClaim.title: AtomicClaim
AtomicClaim.description: A single atomic, independently verifiable interpretive claim derived from tradition rules

claim_id.description: Unique claim identifier — UUIDv4 or deterministic SHA-256 hash of (node_id + rule_id + input_hash)

materiality_weight.description: Impact weight of this claim relative to the user's query objective. Used in LCIw and RNIw calculations. 1.0 = maximally material, 0.0 = irrelevant.

statement.description: Objective deductive statement in the form: '[Subject] [predicate] [conclusion] based on [rule]'. Must NOT contain predictions, must NOT claim future certainty.
examples: The Day Master Geng-Metal (庚金) is assessed as Strong (身旺) because the month branch Shen (申) provides Metal support, per rule BAZI-STRENGTH-001.
Palace 命宫 hosts 紫微 and 天府, indicating primary life path governance by authority and resource accumulation, per rule ZIWEI-PALACE-007.

potential_conflicts.description: Conflicts this claim may have with claims from other tradition domains. Used by L5 Consensus Engine for Cross-Domain Arbitration (H3).

claim_type.description: Classification of claim function within the 5-stage epistemic chain

tags.description: Semantic tags for graph traversal and claim grouping

EpistemicTrace.title: EpistemicTrace
EpistemicTrace.description: Full provenance chain: Source Text → Interpretation → Formal Rule → Rule Instance → Emitted Claim (5-stage epistemic chain per Horo v3.0)

source_corpus.description: Canonical book title in Traditional Chinese (e.g. '滴天髓', '紫微斗数全书')

locator.description: Chapter, volume, stanza, or section reference within the source corpus

original_text.description: Original Classical Chinese text passage that supports this claim

interpretation_id.description: Unique ID of the interpretation step linking source text to formal rule (Stage 2 of epistemic chain)

applied_rule_id.description: Unique ID of the Horo Rule DSL rule that was executed to produce this claim (Stage 3)

derived_from_calc_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the L2 calculation output that triggered this rule execution. Links this claim back to the Derivation DAG node.

rule_version.description: Version of the rule bundle used (SemVer)

ConfidenceVector.title: ConfidenceVector
ConfidenceVector.description: 5-dimensional confidence vector replacing the deprecated scalar confidence score. Each dimension is independently assessable.

calculation_integrity.description: Confidence in the deterministic L2 calculation that underlies this claim. 1.0 = verified against golden test vector, 0.0 = calculation failed or missing.

rule_match_strength.description: Strength of match between the input state and the triggering rule's preconditions. 1.0 = exact match, 0.5 = partial/analogical match.

source_support.description: Degree of explicit support in canonical corpus text. 1.0 = verbatim classical text citation, 0.0 = no corpus provenance (Ungrounded — will raise RNIw alert).

interpretation_stability.description: Stability of this interpretation across different canonical commentators/schools. 1.0 = consensus across all schools, 0.0 = school-specific or contested.

cross_agent_agreement.description: Agreement rate from other tradition agents in L5 Consensus round. 1.0 = all agents agree, 0.0 = contradiction from another domain. Populated by L5, initially 0.0.

PotentialConflict.title: PotentialConflict
PotentialConflict.description: A declared potential conflict between this claim and a claim from another tradition domain

target_domain.description: Tradition domain of the potentially conflicting claim

conflict_nature.description: Description of how this conflict arises
examples: BaZi Day Master weak contradicts QiMen aggressive timing recommendation
ZiWei wealth palace suppressed conflicts FengShui prosperity sector activation

severity.description: Conflict severity weight used in LCIw calculation. 1.0 = irreconcilable hard conflict, 0.0 = minor stylistic difference.

resolution_suggestion.description: Optional suggested resolution strategy for L5 Consensus Engine
examples: Apply STRATEGIC_TIMING_ACTION priority: QiMen > BaZi compatibility
